photo-image.label: PhotoImage component import
photo-image._comment: Image rendering, provider resolution, photo-data validation, shared load-ahead observation and decoded placeholder-colour handoff.

all.label: full package import
all._comment: History/deep links, browser tools, their translated labels and the CSS-only album layouts add contract cost to the full Vue import; retain all other budgets.

module.label: module enabled, no usage
module._comment: Structure CSS (including the CSS-only album layouts), config injection, native provider defaults and Nuxt label-template helpers.

usage.label: module enabled with PhotoImage usage
usage._comment: Structure CSS, shared config, provider-based PhotoImage rendering and photo-data validation.

album.label: module enabled with PhotoAlbum usage
album._comment: Structure CSS, album layouts including grid, bento, mosaic and accordion, gallery/lightbox state, provider images and app-selected labels.
